'''''Enouck''''' was a group of three [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttles]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttles were present at a depot attacked by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Control (CR90 corvette)|''Control'']] that launched three [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]]. The shuttles along with shuttle group ''[[Xarxis]]'' attempted to fight back by attacking the bombers but they were destroyed in the battle.
